note: Plasmacytoid vs. non-plasmacytoid DC split on CD303 × CD123. pDC: dense cluster at the upper-right (CD303+, CD123+) — canonical double-positive pDC signature, well separated from the rest. Non_pDC: broad cloud at the lower-left (CD303-, CD123-) — feeds the myeloid DC branch downstream.
tips: Plasmacytoid vs. non-plasmacytoid DC split. pDC: CD303+ CD123+ (CD303/BDCA-2 is lineage-specific, CD123/IL-3Rα confirms; this double-positive combination is canonical pDC identity). Non_pDC: CD303- CD123-. In-panel co-marker prior: CD123 alone is not pDC-specific within PBMC — basophils are also CD123+ — so the CD303 axis is essential. In this gating tree basophils are already excluded upstream by HLA-DR+ at Step 14 (basophils are HLA-DR-, captured separately at Step 23), so CD123+ events reaching Step 16 should almost entirely be pDCs.
